title: 선주상호보험조합법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Application for Approval of Concurrent Employment) Any permanent director of the association, when seeking approval for concurrent employment in accordance with Article 39 of the Act, must submit the following documents to the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries: <amended March 24, 2013>
1. A document outlining the method for handling concurrent employment in other companies or other legal entities.
2. A document outlining the relationship with other companies or other legal entities.
3. Documents related to the business and assets of the other company or legal entity.
